Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_WEP_LEFT_ST
Description: Weapon posture twist for the left-hand weapon while not two-handing (every value counts as 0 while two-handing; PostureControlParam_WepRight then drives the left arm). Each aNNN group is picked by the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion category (0, 2 or 3; other categories get no twist), and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second).

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist. Used when the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion category is 0. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Left arm inward/outward twist while the active weapon motion category is 0 (this param has categories 0, 2 and 3 only). Used unless a right-hand weapon held with both hands supplies the left side. The chest armor's PostureControlParam_Pro value is used instead when its magnitude is larger. 0: none.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Wrist - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left wrist forward/back bend while the active weapon motion category is 0 (this param has categories 0, 2 and 3 only). Used unless a right-hand weapon held with both hands supplies the left side. 0: none.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Wrist - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Left wrist inward/outward twist while the active weapon motion category is 0 (this param has categories 0, 2 and 3 only). Used unless a right-hand weapon held with both hands supplies the left side. 0: none.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Weapon Rotation
Fields.Description: Rotation of the left-hand weapon while the active weapon motion category is 0 (this param has categories 0, 2 and 3 only). Used unless a right-hand weapon held with both hands supplies the left side. 0: none.
